correctness.rationale: Setting x=phi^(-2N) converts A_N to (2pi/sqrt5)(x^-1-x)tan(pi x/2). Taylor at x=0 gives g_c-A_N=(pi²/sqrt5)(1-pi²/12)x²+O(x⁴), positive leading constant. Dividing consecutive deficits yields ratio phi^-4. The Exner–Turek exact count inequalities A_N<g<=A_(N+1) invert via logarithms to N(g)=log(C_phi/(g_c-g))/(4log phi)+O(1); no uniform additive limiting constant is asserted. Mathematically correct conditional on the cited exact spectral gap theorem. Inspected source floating-point checker is corroborative only; it is not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: The underlying existence/count theorem is assumed from a published paper, not reproved from spectral secular equations.

evidence: Published Section 5 supplies threshold asymptotic; original exact theorem says exactly N open gaps for A_N<g<=A_(N+1).
